Hello everyone! The new story is a sequel to the study abroad series, titled "Alcohol Party.

Gary and Doyle head to a bar to celebrate passing their midterms, but this time, the main focus is on Doyle! Look forward to seeing how Doyle gets physically close with others ❤️

I specially updated my comic cover, and I'm really satisfied with it.

I hope you all enjoy this new story!"
